decision_rule.useful: model minus stop_only on `all` has a 95% interval entirely below zero
decision_rule.better: candidate minus hybrid on `all` has a 95% interval entirely below zero
decision_rule.not_worse_within_type: candidate minus hybrid on `within_type` has an upper bound below +0.02 nats
decision_rule.choose: a useful, better candidate with the lowest `all` point estimate; else hybrid if useful; else no picture model beats the stop habit

reading: nats per held-out choice, lower is better; top1 is a share. Checks the evaluation instrument on known simulated tastes; it measures nothing about real people.
